page_title: ALA 1-0 VAL | Alaves v Valencia 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Luis Garcia Plaza isn't happy on the touchline after referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows him a yellow card.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows the yellow card to Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) for a heavy challenge.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Blanco leaves the pitch and Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) comes on.
87' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Ianis Hagi (Alaves) replaces Jon Guridi.
86' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) gets a yellow card.
86' Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' A cross into the box from Jose Gaya (Valencia) is cleared.
81' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Ander Guevara (Alaves) receives a yellow card!
81' Mario Dominguez (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Duro.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Aleksandar Sedlar is replaced by Samu (Alaves).
75' Substitution. Kike Garcia is replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
70' Substitution. Diego Lopez will be replaced by Selim Amallah (Valencia).
69' Great ball in from Alex Sola. Kike Garcia (Alaves) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
66' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Xeber Alkain and he is replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
66' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Canos (Valencia) comes onto the pitch for Andre Almeida.
59' Pepelu (Valencia) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
57' The attendance is 16641.
57' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Hugo Duro (Valencia) but poses no threat.
55' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
53' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
53' The foul by Xeber Alkain (Alaves) was seen by Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
51' The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' A pass lands at the feet of Luis Rioja (Alaves) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) is replaced by Cristhian Mosquera.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ruben Baraja probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Thierry Correia. He is replaced by Francisco Perez (Valencia).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Jose Gaya (Valencia) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+2' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
40' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Kike Garcia (Alaves) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
38' Yellow card. Jon Guridi (Alaves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
31' Thierry Correia (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
25' Alaves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
22' Luis Rioja (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

20' Javi Guerra (Valencia) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
15' A clumsy foul by Ander Guevara (Alaves) and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
10' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
5' Kike Garcia (Alaves) fails to score from the penalty spot. His effort towards the bottom left corner lacks any pace and that allows the goalkeeper to make a stunning save.
5' Kike Garcia (Alaves) will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
3' Kike Garcia (Alaves) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a superb save.
3' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
2' Alaves have been awarded a penalty kick!
2' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes is introduced as the referee for today's match.
